svg.title: Collected fee to case contribution
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-fee-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: Collected fee to case contribution; subtitle: Keep the claimant distribution separate; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD; opening and closing bars are totals, intervening bars are signed deductions. Assume a permitted 10% fee on a $50,000 claimant recovery.; caption: $5,000 collected less $600 records, $900 professional review and $1,000 acquisition allocation leaves $2,500 before overhead, owner compensation and tax.; stages: label: Collected fee; value: $5,000; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Opening total; assumes lawful compensation and actual receipt, not an unsigned prospective fee.; label: Evidence costs; value: -$600; numeric value: -600.0; detail: Certified deeds, docket copies, identity documents and research labor paid by the business.; label: Professional review; value: -$900; numeric value: -900.0; detail: Illustrative business-paid review cost; not a statutory deduction from claimant proceeds.; label: Acquisition allocation; value: -$1,000; numeric value: -1000.0; detail: Includes outreach and screening expense for unsuccessful records in the same cohort.; label: Case contribution; value: $2,500; numeric value: 2500.0; detail: Closing total, not another movement; deduct fixed overhead before describing owner profit.
